details: The US economy added 172,000 nonfarm payroll jobs in May, exceeding expectations and demonstrating continued resilience in the labor market. This robust employment data is reducing hopes for near-term interest rate cuts by the Federal Reserve, with some market participants now pricing in a potential rate hike by December. Higher interest rates typically make safer yield-bearing investments more attractive, consequently putting pressure on risk assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: US Strong Jobs Data Fuels Rate Hike Bets, Pressuring Crypto

details: This week's upcoming US Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI) reports are highly anticipated, as they will provide crucial insights into the Federal Reserve's future monetary policy. Consensus expectations suggest the annual CPI rate could rise to 4.2%. Persistent inflation above 4% and producer prices exceeding 6% could strengthen the case for the Fed to maintain or even further implement restrictive monetary policy, a scenario that would likely be bearish for Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies.
title: Elevated US Inflation Expected, CPI and PPI to Guide Fed Policy

details: Ongoing geopolitical tensions, marked by recent missile exchanges between Iran and Israel, continue to influence global financial markets. While initial market reactions to perceived de-escalation efforts led to a brief rally in Bitcoin, the sustained conflict contributes to overall market uncertainty. Persistent instability in the Middle East is generally bearish for risk assets and could lead to increased regulatory scrutiny over cryptocurrency transactions, particularly those associated with sanctioned entities.
title: Geopolitical Tensions Persist Between Iran and Israel, Impacting Markets

details: Bank of America Securities has issued a warning that 70% of its proprietary bear market indicators have now been triggered for the S&P 500 index. This assessment suggests that the US stock market may be nearing a peak and exhibiting signs of excessive speculation. Elevated valuations and market gains being driven by a narrow group of companies indicate a potential "soft patch ahead" for equities, which could have ripple effects on other risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: Bank of America Flags Bearish Signals for US Stock Market

details: Following a recent small sale of Bitcoin—its first since 2022—MicroStrategy Executive Chairman Michael Saylor hinted at a potential resumption of the company's Bitcoin accumulation strategy. Saylor's post on social media, featuring a chart typically used to signal upcoming purchases, suggests continued institutional confidence and a reaffirmation of MicroStrategy's long-term conviction in Bitcoin, despite recent market volatility.
title: MicroStrategy's Saylor Hints at Renewed Bitcoin Buying

details: CME Group, recognized as the world's largest derivatives marketplace, has officially launched 24/7 trading for its cryptocurrency futures and options. This strategic move aims to provide continuous liquidity and better align traditional regulated financial markets with the inherently round-the-clock nature of digital assets. The expanded trading hours cover Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other major cryptocurrencies, signaling a further integration of crypto into mainstream finance.
title: CME Group Launches 24/7 Crypto Futures and Options Trading
